description: Pedestrian Counting System - Past Hour (counts per minute) is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. Current issue 23/09/2020 Please note: Sensors 67, 68 and 69 are showing duplicate records. We are currently working on a fix to resolve this. This dataset contains minute by minute directional pedestrian counts for the last hour from pedestrian sensor devices located across the city. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are foot-traffic, pedestrian, safemobility, sensors, traffic-flow. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv, json, kml, xls. The portal shows 2024-06-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
